findings.evidence: "Before reporting, re-Read each cited range and confirm the snippet matches those exact lines; otherwise fix the range or the snippet." If this final read fails because the source disappeared or became unreadable, neither prescribed repair resolves the branch, and the source-verification completion requirement remains unmet.
findings.fix: Add a verification-failure branch: omit any snippet that cannot be reverified, report the affected path and read failure, and continue with verified candidates. If none remain, report that verification was blocked rather than claiming no implementations matched.
